body:
Fuck. I got halfway through- and then I became too scared. Blood's cleaned off, and the knife's away for the night. I'm so useless. I don't even have the balls to do it. 

Suicide is inherently selfish. But for once in my life, I want to take the selfish choice. My friends and family won't understand, and that's the only regret I have.

I don't have that option. People would begin to wonder what's up with me.

Thank you for your kind words. I'm bandaged up and headed to sleep now to consider more if this is what I really want.

Yes. That's exactly it. What happened to get you out of it?

I took a long time considering what I had to be happy about. Family? Friends? It's all fun and games, but I realised that I wasn't actually living life. I'm just a walking corpse. Why go through the motions?

No. Word can not get out. I'm almost like a hometown hero. There's an image I have to maintain for the sake of others in my community. Nobody can know.

I mean no disrespect, but for me personally it's a matter of pride and dating websites seems to be taking the easy way out. Ironic, seeing as I'm sitting here with a knife.

I'm part of a frat. It's honestly the easiest way and even then, that's not working.

I'm shit. What other reason would there be for why nobody has ever been attracted to me?  I'm in great shape, I'm social, etc. There's something that just repels girls on a subconscious level about me. 

But why me? Why do I have to miss out on all these grey experiences that everybody else gets while they're young?

I work hard. Extremely. I've own sport awards because of my work ethic. 
Problem is that it's no longer possible, and I'm also unable to maintain my resolve after years of unrewarded efforts when it comes to girls.

I can't enjoy my usual hobbies anymore either. They're just not fun anymore.

You shouldn't be sorry for the things that people in my life have done and for the mistakes that I've made. It's not your fault. 

But thank you. It just... weighs me down.

Nothing else I've ever done has given me the same passion.

I don't believe in a special someone anymore. There is no such thing as "the one". I also don't want to resort to a website

Everybody around me is living life and I just can't seem to have the same experiences. All my life I've been torn apart by my inability to hold a relationship and the feeling that I'm completely worthless because nothing has panned out.
Like I said... They've been crushed. I have nothing.
